```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

# subject courses
subject_courses <- read.table('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Flica_Output/ABIDE/iterations1500/FSL_Format/150ica_secondfilter/subjectCoursesOut.txt')
subject_courses_tp <- t(subject_courses)

# modality contirbutions
modality_contributions <- read.table('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Flica_Output/ABIDE/iterations1500/FSL_Format/150ica_secondfilter/Modality_contributions.txt')
#this is shown as modalities in the rows and IC in the colums, we want to transpose it
modality_contributions_tp <- t(modality_contributions)# now the columns are modalities

subject_courses_tp <- subject_courses_tp[, colSums(subject_courses_tp == 0) != nrow(subject_courses_tp)]
```

#### Between Group: autism vs. NAI ####
```{r}
# load phenotypic data
behaviourals_all <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/FSL_pheno_second_filter.csv')
behaviourals_all$SUB_ID <- as.character(as.integer(behaviourals_all$SUB_ID)) #convert into string
behaviourals_all$SITE_ID <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SITE_ID) #categorical / factor

# stats (ANCOVA, interaction) # sex by diagnosis interaction
ICs <- ncol(subject_courses_tp)
pvals_comb <- matrix(0, nrow=ICs, ncol=5)
tvals_comb <- matrix(0, nrow=ICs, ncol=5)

# loop over ICs
for (i in 1:ICs){
  y <- subject_courses_tp[,i]
  x <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP) #because categorical
  z <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SEX) #because categorical
  c1 <- behaviourals_all$AGE_AT_SCAN #continuous
  c2 <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SITE_ID) #because categorical
  
  ols <- lm(y ~ x*z + c1 + c2) 
  coef_table <- summary(ols)$coefficients

  pvals_comb[i,1] <- coef_table["x2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  pvals_comb[i,2] <- coef_table["z2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  pvals_comb[i,3] <- coef_table["x2:z2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  pvals_comb[i,4] <- coef_table["c1", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  pvals_comb[i,5] <- anova(ols)["c2", "Pr(>F)"]
  tvals_comb[i,1] <- coef_table["x2", "t value"]
  tvals_comb[i,2] <- coef_table["z2", "t value"]
  tvals_comb[i,3] <- coef_table["x2:z2", "t value"]
}

# FDR correction
pvals_corrected_dx <- p.adjust(pvals_comb[,1], method="BH")
pvals_corrected_sex <- p.adjust(pvals_comb[,2], method="BH")
pvals_corrected_interaction <- p.adjust(pvals_comb[,3], method="BH")

# Interaction
sig_int <- which(pvals_corrected_interaction < 0.05)
if(length(sig_int) > 0) {
  cat("Interaction - significant ICs:", sig_int, "\n")
} else {
  cat("No significant interactions\n")
} 


## Additive model (only main effect, looking at diagnosis group differences) ## 

ICs <- ncol(subject_courses_tp)
pvals_add <- matrix(NA, nrow=ICs, ncol=4)
tvals_add <- matrix(NA, nrow=ICs, ncol=4)

# loop over ICs
for (i in 1:ICs){
  y <- subject_courses_tp[,i]
  x <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP) #because categorical
  z <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SEX) #because categorical
  c1 <- behaviourals_all$AGE_AT_SCAN #continuous
  c2 <- as.factor(behaviourals_all$SITE_ID) #because categorical
  
  ols <- lm(y ~ x + z + c1 + c2) 
  coef_table <- summary(ols)$coefficients

  pvals_add[i,1] <- coef_table["x2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  pvals_add[i,2] <- coef_table["z2", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  pvals_add[i,3] <- coef_table["c1", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  pvals_add[i,4] <- anova(ols)["c2", "Pr(>F)"]
  tvals_add[i,1] <- coef_table["x2", "t value"]
  tvals_add[i,2] <- coef_table["z2", "t value"]
  tvals_add[i,3] <- coef_table["c1", "t value"]
}

# FDR correction
pvals_add_dx   <- p.adjust(pvals_add[,1], method="BH")

# Main effect of diagnosis
sig_dx <- which(pvals_add_dx < 0.05)
if(length(sig_dx) > 0) {
  cat("Diagnosis - significant ICs:", sig_dx, "\n")
} else {
  cat("No significant diagnosis effects\n")
}

#uncorrected 
cat("IC37 diagnosis: t =", round(tvals_add[37, 1], 3),
    "| p (uncorrected) =", signif(pvals_add[37, 1], 3),
    "| p_FDR =", round(pvals_add_dx[37], 4), "\n")

# Diagnosis site interaction for IC37
y <- subject_courses_tp[, 37]
m0 <- lm(y ~ x + z + c1 + c2)
m1 <- lm(y ~ x * c2 + z + c1)
anova(m0, m1)  

modality_contributions_tp[c(37), ]

tapply(subject_courses_tp[,37], behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP, mean)
tapply(subject_courses_tp[,37], behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP, range)

n1 <- sum(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP == levels(as.factor(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP))[1])
n2 <- sum(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP == levels(as.factor(behaviourals_all$DX_GROUP))[2])

# degrees of freedom
df.residual(m0)              # df2 
tvals_add[37, 1]              # t
tvals_add[37, 1]^2            # F = t²
pvals_add_dx[37]              # FDR-corrected p
d <- tvals_add[37, 1] * sqrt((n1 + n2) / (n1 * n2))
```

# Within Group: Symptom association
```{r}
# We want only ASD for these analyses
behaviourals_all <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/FSL_pheno_second_filter.csv')
subject_courses_tp_ids <- data.frame(SUB_ID = behaviourals_all$SUB_ID, 
                                      subject_courses_tp) # adding sub id to the subject courses

behaviourals_ASD <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Imputation/imputed_data_final_FSL.csv') 

# making sure sub ids are in the right order
subject_courses_ASD <- subject_courses_tp_ids[match(behaviourals_ASD$SUB_ID, subject_courses_tp_ids$SUB_ID), ]
cat("IDs in same order?", all(subject_courses_ASD$SUB_ID == behaviourals_ASD$SUB_ID))
cat("Same IDs", all(sort(subject_courses_ASD$SUB_ID) == sort(behaviourals_ASD$SUB_ID)))

subject_courses_ASD_matrix <- as.matrix(subject_courses_ASD[, -1])

ICs <- ncol(subject_courses_ASD_matrix)
behav_vars <- c("ADOS_2_total_gotham_harmonized", "ADOS_2_socaff_harmonized",
                "ADOS_2_severity_harmonized",
                "ADI_R_VERBAL_TOTAL_BV","ADI_R_SOCIAL_TOTAL_A", 
                "ADI_R_NONVERBAL_TOTAL_BV", "ADOS_2_rrb_harmonized", "ADI_RRB_harmonized")

pvals_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = ICs, ncol = length(behav_vars), 
                       dimnames = list(NULL, behav_vars))
tvals_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = ICs, ncol = length(behav_vars),
                       dimnames = list(NULL, behav_vars))
beta_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = ICs, ncol = length(behav_vars),
                      dimnames = list(NULL, behav_vars))

for (v in seq_along(behav_vars)) {
  var <- behav_vars[v]
  for (i in 1:ICs) {
    y  <- subject_courses_ASD_matrix[, i]
    x  <- behaviourals_ASD[[var]]
    c1 <- behaviourals_ASD$AGE_AT_SCAN
    c2 <- as.factor(behaviourals_ASD$SEX)
    c3 <- as.factor(behaviourals_ASD$SITE_ID)
    
    ols <- lm(y ~ x + c1 + c2 + c3)
    pvals_matrix[i, v] <- summary(ols)$coefficients['x', 'Pr(>|t|)']
    tvals_matrix[i, v] <- summary(ols)$coefficients['x', 't value']
    beta_matrix[i, v]  <- summary(ols)$coefficients["x", "Estimate"]
  }
}

# joint FDR correction across all values at once
pvals_corrected <- matrix(p.adjust(pvals_matrix, method = "BH"), 
                          nrow = ICs, ncol = length(behav_vars),
                          dimnames = list(NULL, behav_vars))

# print significant results
for (var in behav_vars) {
  sig <- which(pvals_corrected[, var] < 0.05)
  if (length(sig) > 0) {
    cat(var, "- significant ICs:", sig,
    "| b =", round(beta_matrix[sig, var], 3),
    "| t =", round(tvals_matrix[sig, var], 3),
    "| p_fdr =", round(pvals_corrected[sig, var], 4), "\n")
  }
}

ols <- lm(subject_courses_ASD_matrix[,1] ~ behaviourals_ASD$ADOS_2_total_gotham_harmonized +
          behaviourals_ASD$AGE_AT_SCAN + as.factor(behaviourals_ASD$SEX) +
          as.factor(behaviourals_ASD$SITE_ID))
df.residual(ols)

modality_contributions_tp[c(1), ]

# Higher IC1 loadings are associated with higher ADOS scores.
# Participants with more severe autism symptoms show stronger expression of the IC1 pattern.

#standardised beta
y <- subject_courses_ASD_matrix[, 1]

for (var in c("ADOS_2_total_gotham_harmonized", "ADOS_2_severity_harmonized")) {
  ols <- lm(scale(y) ~ scale(behaviourals_ASD[[var]]) +
              behaviourals_ASD$AGE_AT_SCAN +
              as.factor(behaviourals_ASD$SEX) +
              as.factor(behaviourals_ASD$SITE_ID))
  print(round(summary(ols)$coefficients[2, ], 3))   # beta, SE, t, p
}

## plot for thesis
scatter_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 7)
  )

make_scatter <- function(x, xlab, ttl) {
  df <- data.frame(ADOS = x, IC1 = subject_courses_ASD_matrix[, 1])
  ggplot(df, aes(x = ADOS, y = IC1)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, colour = "navy") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "red", fill = "pink", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scatter_theme +
    labs(title = ttl, x = xlab, y = "IC1 loading")
}

s_total <- make_scatter(behaviourals_ASD$ADOS_2_total_gotham_harmonized,
                        "ADOS-2 total", "ADOS-2 total")
s_css   <- make_scatter(behaviourals_ASD$ADOS_2_severity_harmonized,
                        "ADOS-2 CSS", "ADOS-2 calibrated severity")

p_scatter <- s_total + s_css
p_scatter

ggsave('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/IC1_ADOS_scatter_panel.pdf',
       p_scatter, width = 11.5, height = 4.5, units = "cm")
```
